designLanguage.rationale: The concept of a gnome on a one-wheeled contraption with a large wrench is well-aligned with the Crawler design language. The combination of a whimsical vehicle and a serious weapon creates a humorous yet threatening contradiction. However, the design could push the 'improvised' aspect of the machine further to enhance the dark-fantasy industrial vibe.
